responsibility: Header for runtime-independent Objective-C metadata construction helpers. It declares the shared routines used by runtime ABI files and objc-act.cc to build structs, arrays, constructors, variable declarations, selectors, method and ivar templates, protocol references, module descriptors, string pools, function starts, and declaration dumps, forming the common utility API beneath the runtime hook implementations.
same_name_distinction: Shared-support API header for Objective-C runtime metadata construction, declaring the helper functions and exported variables used by objc-act.cc and runtime-specific back ends. Unlike objc-runtime-shared-support.cc, it serves as the declaration surface rather than implementing metadata/template generation.
